title: SearchRequest
description: Inbound contract for WEBIS-SEARCH. Every field that widens the search surface is explicit, reviewable and logged; the agent infers nothing about scope.

subject.description: Legal name (or person name) as it appears on the KYC file.

case_id.description: Links the pack back to the CDD case; absent only for standalone runs.

attributes.description: Discriminators used by SK-S5b. Absent attributes never exclude a source.

related_parties.description: UBOs and directors, screened in their own right (SK-S1).

retrieved_at.description: Pinned clock. Two runs with the same value must be byte-identical.
